data.explanation: The letting agency has reserved apartment 3.12 for you. To keep the reservation, you need to sign the lease and transfer the deposit, then send proof of both back to them by the date shown. If you miss it, they say they will offer the apartment to someone else, so it is worth doing this well before the deadline. The deposit amount itself is not stated in this letter, so check your lease document for the exact figure before transferring money.

items.action: Sign the lease, transfer the security deposit, and send proof of both (signed lease + transfer confirmation) to the landlord.
items.consequence: The apartment will be released to the next applicant.
items.quote: To complete the booking, please return the signed lease together with proof that you have transferred the deposit by 08/09/2027.
